text.title: xUnit Testing Core Rules
text.summary: 10 testable rules grounding the xUnit + Moq + WAF testing methodology. Each rule pairs a binary check + sourced rationale.

rule.statement: Every reachable branch in production code MUST be covered by at least one `[Fact]` or `[Theory]` `InlineData` row. Tests MUST name the branch via `MethodUnderTest_State_ExpectedBehaviour`.

rationale.source: Roy Osherove — Art of Unit Testing

rule.rationale: Generic test names ("UserServiceTest1") hide what regression a failure represents; the convention turns CI output into a self-documenting bug report.

rule.statement: Test fixtures MUST inject dependencies via the constructor — never via `[OneTimeSetUp]`/`[TestInitialize]` equivalents. State that survives across tests MUST live in an `IClassFixture<T>`.
rule.rationale: xUnit creates a new instance per test; constructor injection makes the lifecycle explicit and prevents hidden cross-test state.

rule.statement: Assertions on collections, complex objects, JSON responses, or extracted fields MUST use FluentAssertions (`actual.Should().BeEquivalentTo(expected)`). Raw `Assert.Equal(list1, list2)` is forbidden for non-trivial structures; primitives may use `Should().Be(...)`.
rule.rationale: FluentAssertions emits a multiline structural diff; `Assert.Equal` on collections produces a single-line `Expected: X; Actual: Y` dump with no clue which element or field failed.

rule.statement: Every async test method MUST return `Task` (or `ValueTask`). `async void` is forbidden except for legacy event-handler tests.
rule.rationale: The xUnit runner cannot observe exceptions on a non-awaitable signature, so an `async void` test either passes silently while the assertion failed, or takes the runner down. Enforce with the `xUnit1031` analyzer at warning-as-error.

rule.statement: Controller integration tests MUST use `IClassFixture<WebApplicationFactory<Program>>` or a derived test factory that overrides `ConfigureWebHost` to substitute the `DbContext` — SQLite-in-memory for low-fidelity, Testcontainers for high-fidelity. The production database and real external APIs MUST NOT be touched. `Program.cs` MUST expose `public partial class Program { }`.
rule.rationale: `IClassFixture` shares one host across the class, amortizing the startup cost that otherwise dominates the suite, and substituting the DbContext is what makes the tests deterministic. Top-level statements declare `Program` as internal, so without the partial shim the test project cannot compile against `WebApplicationFactory<Program>` at all.

rule.statement: Parametric tests MUST use `[Theory]` with `[InlineData(...)]`, or `[MemberData]`/`[ClassData]` for complex types — never duplicated `[Fact]` methods. The name carries the input and the expected output: `Add_TwoPositives_ReturnsSum`.
rule.rationale: `[Theory]` reports each case as its own test result, so CI names the failing case; duplicated `[Fact]`s hide which input broke and drift apart as one is edited.

rule.statement: Moq `Setup` arguments MUST use precise matchers (`It.Is<T>(x => x.Id == 1)`) by default, and expected interactions MUST be asserted with `mock.Verify(..., Times.Once)`. `It.IsAny<T>()` is allowed only where the test explicitly does not care about that argument.
rule.rationale: `It.IsAny<T>()` masks divergence between the setup and the code: the test still passes when production calls the mock with the wrong arguments, or with the right ones the wrong number of times.

rule.statement: Integration tests MUST use `WebApplicationFactory<Program>` (or equivalent), replacing real external dependencies via `builder.ConfigureTestServices(...)`. `HttpClient` MUST be constructed from `factory.CreateClient()` — never `new HttpClient()`.
rule.rationale: The factory boots the actual DI graph + middleware; ad-hoc `new HttpClient` bypasses the host and tests nothing.

rule.statement: Data-layer tests MUST run against the real database engine via Testcontainers (e.g. `PostgreSqlContainer`). `UseInMemoryDatabase` is forbidden for tests that exercise queries, constraints, or migrations.
rule.rationale: InMemory diverges from real DBs on JSONB ops, locking, FK behaviour; tests pass in CI and fail in prod.

rule.statement: CI MUST enforce a coverage gate: line ≥ 70 %, branch ≥ 60 %, via Coverlet + ReportGenerator. Build fails when thresholds drop.
rule.rationale: Coverage without a gate is advisory only; agents skip uncovered paths unless the build blocks.
